y-m-50-04.title: Haddii hawl isku-dhaf ah ay tahay mid-ku-mid, labada hawlood ma labaduba waa mid-ku-mid?
y-m-50-04.topic: Waxa aan ka odhan karno f iyo g marka hawsha isku-dhafka g∘f ay tahay mid-ku-mid
y-m-50-04.goal: Si toos ah u hel qiimayaasha hawsha isku-dhafka ee shaxda la bixiyey si aad u tijaabiso sheegashada Eunsu, oo sharax sida hal qayb oo sheegashada ah ay u jabto tusaale lid ku ah halka qaybta kale ay run tahay.
y-m-50-04.material:
Waxaa jira ururro X={1, 2}, Y={a, b, c}, Z={p, q, r}. Hawlaha f: X→Y iyo g: Y→Z waa sidan.
f(1)=a, f(2)=b
g(a)=p, g(b)=q, g(c)=p
Hawsha isku-dhafka g∘f waxay u meelaysaa g(f(x)) xubin x ee X. Hawl mid-ku-mid waa hawl halkaas oo laba xubnood oo kala duwan oo goobta ah ay had iyo jeer leeyihiin qiimayaal kala duwan.
Sheegashada Eunsu: "Haddii g∘f ay tahay hawl mid-ku-mid, markaas labadaba f iyo g waa hawlo mid-ku-mid."

Is-waafajin mid-ku-mid iyo hawlaha rogan lama isticmaalo.

y-m-50-03.title: Dhaqdhaqaaq kadibna rogid vs rogid kadibna dhaqdhaqaaq: natiijadu ma isku mid tahay?
y-m-50-03.topic: Kala horreynta wareejinta garaaf iyo ka laabidda dhidibka x (shuruudda natiijooyinka ay isku mid noqdaan)
y-m-50-03.goal: Ku xaqiiji tusaale lid ku ah in garaafka natiijadu uu kala duwanaan karo iyadoo ku xidhan kala horreynta wareejinta iyo ka laabidda dhidibka x, naftaada u hel xaaladaha halkaas oo beddelidda kala horreyntu ay siiso isla garaaf, oo sharax sababta adigoo isticmaalaya booska geeska.
y-m-50-03.material:
Aan garaafka y=x² u beddelno laba kala horreyn.
Habka A: Marka hore ka laab dhidibka x, kadibna u wareeji p jihada x iyo q jihada y.
Habka B: Marka hore u wareeji p jihada x iyo q jihada y, kadibna ka laab dhidibka x.
(p togan macnaheedu waa dhaqaajinta midig p taban na bidix, q togan na kor q taban na hoos. Ka laabidda dhidibka x macnaheedu waa rogidda kor-hoos.)
Minho wuxuu yiri, "Xataa haddii aad kala horreynta beddesho, garaafka natiijadu had iyo jeer waa isku mid."

y-m-50-06.material:
'Garaafka shaqada f(x)=√(x-1)+2 (x≥1) waa qalooc ka bilaabmaya dhibicda (1, 2) oo si tartiib ah ugu kordhaya dhanka midig. (√ waxaa loo akhriyaa 'xididka labajibaaran', √(x-1) wuxuu yahay 'xididka labajibaaran ee x laga jaray 1'.) Tusaalooyinka qiyamka: f(1)=2, f(2)=3, f(5)=4, f(10)=5.
Waxaan kor iyo hoos u dhaqaajinaa xariiqda y=x+k (jiif 1, k waa joogto). Seohyun waxay leedahay, "Haddii k weynaado, xariiqdu way kor u kacdaa, sidaa darteed tirada dhibcaha ay la kulanto garaafka way sii kordhaysaa."'

y-m-50-08.title: Shaqada Eunji ee tirada is-goynta: safka kee ayaa khaldan?
y-m-50-08.topic: Tirada is-goynta garaafka y=|x²-2x-3| iyo xariiqda siman y=m (loo kala saaray xadka m)
y-m-50-08.goal: Hel safka khaldan ee shaqo baartay tirada is-goynta garaafka shaqada labajibbaarka leh qiimaha saafiga ah iyo xariiq siman iyadoo la eegayo xadka m, ku hubi adigoo toos u geliyey qiimayaal, oo sax.
y-m-50-08.material: Tani waa shaqada Eunji si loo helo tirada baraha garaafka shaqada f(x)=|x²-2x-3| ay la kulanto xariiqda siman y=m (m waa joogto). (|a| waxaa loo akhriyaa 'qiimaha saafiga ah ee a'.) Sawir ma jiro.
y-m-50-08.thinking.1: Si toos ah ugu hubi adigoo geliyey qiimayaal
y-m-50-08.thinking.2: Habee adigoo u kala qaybinaya kiisas iyadoo loo eegayo xadka
y-m-50-08.prereq.0: 'H1' ee hawshan waa oo keliya calaamad adkaan ee qoondaynta soo saarista macnaheedu maaha in manhajku wax-ku-ku-barta waxyaabahan fasal gaar ah. Malo-awaal: ka soo qaad inaad horay u taqaanid garaafka shaqada labajibbaarka (fiiqda, baraha ay la kulanto dhidibka x), macnaha calaamadda qiimaha saafiga ah (|a| waa -a haddii a uu taban yahay), in garaafka y=|f(x)| uu yahay garaafka y=f(x) oo qaybta dhidibka x ka hooseysa kor loo laabay, iyo sida loo xalliyo isla'eg labajibbaar.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal safka khaldan ee shaqada Eunji. (Lambarrada safafka waxaa laga bilaabaa 1.)
y-m-50-08.s.s1.hint.0: Marka m=4, eeg haddii ay jirto meel laamaha dibadda (x>3, x<-1) ah, ma aha qaybta la laabay, halka y noqonayso 4.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.hint.1: Xisaabi qiimayaasha f(x) marka x=3 iyo x=4 oo hubi haddii 4 u dhexeeyo.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.0: x²-2x-3=(x-3)(x+1), sidaas darteed garaafka y=x²-2x-3 wuxuu la kulmaa dhidibka x marka x=-1 iyo x=3, fiiqdiisuna waa (1, -4).
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.1: Qiimaha saafiga ah awgeed, qaybta hoose ee dhidibka x (-1<x<3) waxaa lagu laabay dhidibka x kore. Sare ee qaybta la laabay waa (1, 4).
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.2: Haddii m=4, waxay ku kulmaan fiiqda qaybta la laabay (1, 4) oo keliya, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 1 is-goyn.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.3: Haddii 0<m<4, waxay la kulantaa qaybta la laabay laba bar iyo mid laan dibadeed kasta oo labada ah, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 4 is-goyn.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.4: Haddii m>4, ma taabato qaybta la laabay oo waxay la kulantaa mid laan dibadeed kasta oo labada ah, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 2 is-goyn.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.line.5: Haddii m=0, waxay ku kulmaan labada bar ee dhidibka x, x=-1 iyo x=3, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 2 is-goyn.
y-m-50-08.s.s1.explain: Safka 3 waa khaldan yahay. Waa sax in marka m=4 ay ku kulmaan fiiqda la laabay (1, 4), laakiin labada laan dibadeed sidoo kale waxay maraan y=4. Tusaale ahaan, qiimuhu waa 0 marka x=3 iyo 5 marka x=4, sidaas darteed waxay maraan y=4 dhexdooda (x=1+2√2). Dhinaca kale waa isku mid, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 3 wadar ahaan. Safafka 1, 2, 4, 5, iyo 6 waa sax.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.prompt: Samee saddex qiime oo kala duwan oo m ah oo ay jiraan si sax ah 4 is-goyn. Waxaad qori kartaa tobanaadyo.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka bilow adigoo dejinaya qiime fudud sida m=1 ama 2 oo tiri imisa bar ayay la kulantaa qaybta la laabay iyo laamaha dibadda.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.hint.1: Marka aad kordhiso m, hel qiimaha tirada is-goynta ay marka ugu horreysay isbeddesho.

y-m-50-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Haddii m yahay 4 ama ka badan, tirada baraha la kulma qaybta la laabay way yaraataa. Barbar dhig dhererka fiiqda la laabay.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Fadlan ilaali m inta u dhexeysa -10 iyo 10.
y-m-50-08.s.s2.explain: Haddii 0<m<4, waxaa jira laba bar qaybta la laabay iyo hal bar laan dibadeed kasta oo labada ah, sidaas darteed 4 wadar ahaan. Haddii m=0 waxaa jira 2, haddii m=4 waa 3, haddii m>4 waa 2, haddii m<0 na waa 0.
y-m-50-08.s.s3.prompt: Qor sida loogu hubiyo adigoo isticmaalaya odhaahyo in ay jiraan 3 is-goyn marka m=4. (Xalli |x²-2x-3|=4 adigoo u kala qaybinaya laba kiis.)

y-m-50-08.s.s3.model.0: Haddii x²-2x-3=4, markaas x²-2x-7=0, sidaas darteed x=1±2√2, taasoo ah laba; haddii x²-2x-3=-4, markaas (x-1)²=0, sidaas darteed x=1, taasoo ah hal. Isku darka waa 3.
y-m-50-08.s.s3.model.1: |x²-2x-3|=4 macnaheedu waa x²-2x-3=4 ama x²-2x-3=-4. Midka koowaad wuxuu leeyahay discriminant 32, taasoo togan, sidaas darteed laba xidid dhab ah oo kala duwan, midka labaadna wuxuu leeyahay hal xidid labanlaab. Tani waa 3 wadar ahaan, waana qiimayaal kala duwan.

y-m-50-05.title: Laba asymptote iyo hal dhibic: ma go'aansan tahay garaafku?
y-m-50-05.topic: Macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo go'aamiyo garaafka shaqada jajabka y=a+k/(x-p) (asymptotes iyo dhibic ay maraan)
y-m-50-05.goal: Ku xukun in asymptotes oo keliya aanay shaqada ka dhigin mid keliya, in ku darista dhibic ay maraan ay go'aamiso, iyo in shuruudo badan ay is-khilaafi karaan; dib u eeg ama ilaali xukunkaaga, oo adigu samee shuruudaha is-khilaafsan kuwee la shakiyo.
y-m-50-05.material: Macluumaadka ku saabsan garaafka hal shaqo jajab ah wuxuu yimaadaa hal qayb mar mar. Sawir ma jiro. Tibaax sida 'y waa le'eg 3 oo lagu daray k kala (x laga jaray 2)' sidaas ayaa loo akhriyaa. Asymptote waa xariiq garaafku aad u dhawaado laakiin aanu waligii la kulmin.
y-m-50-05.thinking.0: Dib u eeg xukun marka macluumaadku kordho
y-m-50-05.thinking.1: Hubi in shuruudaha ay is-khilaafsan yihiin
y-m-50-05.thinking.2: Is barbar dhig oo qiimee shuruudda la shakiyo
y-m-50-05.prereq.0: 'H1' ee hawshan waa calaamad adag oo keliya oo ku jirta qoondaynta soo saarista mana ahan in manhajku wax ku baraa fasal gaar ah. Aasaas: ka soo qaad inaad horey u taqaan in garaafka shaqada jajabka y=k/(x-p)+q (k≠0) uu leeyahay laba xariiq x=p iyo y=q oo asymptotes ah, iyo sida loo geliyo isku-dubbaridka dhibic tibaax si loo waafajiyo qiimaha.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal qayb mar mar. Mar kasta, ku xukun macluumaadka ilaa hadda jira, marka macluumaad cusub yimaado, go'aami inaad ilaalinayso ama dib u eegayso xukunkaaga.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.hint.0: Macluumaad kasta geli tibaaxda oo tiri immisa wax aan la oga ayaa hadhay.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.hint.1: Macluumaadka cusub geli tibaaxda hore la helay oo si toos ah u xisaabi inay waafaqayso.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Wax kaliya oo laga ogyahay garaafka shaqo jajab ah waa in asymptote-kiisa toosan uu yahay xariiqda x=2 iyo asymptote-kiisa jiifka ahi uu yahay xariiqda y=3. Shaqadani waxay leedahay qaabka y=3+k/(x-2) (k waa joogto aan eber ahayn).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ma go'aansan tahay shaqadu hal macluumaadkan oo keliya?
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Haddii k uu yahay 2, 5, ama -3, asymptotes-ku waa isku mid, x=2 iyo y=3. Asymptotes-ku waxay oranayaan oo keliya 'qaab-dhismeedka' meesha garaafku ku yaal, ma sheegaan k (inta garaafku foorarsanayo, afar-meelood kuwee ku yaal).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waa go'aansan yahay. Laba asymptote ayaa la bixiyay, sidaa darteed k sidoo kale waa go'aansan yahay
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Xitaa haddii k uu yahay 2 ama 5, asymptotes-ku waa isku mid, x=2 iyo y=3. Hubi inaad ogaan karto qiimaha k adigoo eegaya asymptotes keliya.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ma go'aansana. Garaafyada leh qiyamo k oo kala duwan dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin asymptotes-kan
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ma go'aansana. Hal asymptote oo kale ayaa loo baahan yahay
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Shaqo jajab ah oo noocan ah waxay leedahay sax ahaan laba asymptote. Waxa yaraaday maaha tirada asymptotes laakiin nooc kale oo macluumaad ah oo go'aamiya k.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Macluumaad cusub oo la bixiyay: garaafkani wuxuu maraa dhibicda (0, 1).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Marka la geliyo x=0, y=1 waxay bixisaa 1=3+k/(0-2)=3-k/2, sidaa darteed k=4. Garaafku waa go'aansan yahay y=3+4/(x-2), taasi waa, y=(3x-2)/(x-2).
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Marka aad geliso x=0, y=1 tibaaxda, hubi inaad x=0 gelisay x-2 markaad xisaabinayso. Hal calaamad ayaa laga yaabaa inay khaldan tahay.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Gelinta hal dhibic tibaaxda waxay abuurtaa hal isla'eg oo ku saabsan k. Ka fikir in isla'egtaasi leedahay hal xal.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Macluumaad dheeraad ah: garaafkani wuxuu sidoo kale maraa dhibicda (4, 6). Laakiin haddii aad geliso x=4 y=3+4/(x-2) ee hore la helay, waxaad helaysaa y=5.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sidee ayaad u qaadan doontaa macluumaadkan cusub?
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Haddii aad asymptote y=3 sidiisa ilaaliso, garaaf midna labada dhibic ma maro. Haddii aad asymptote-ka jiifka ah u daysid furan sida y=a, markaas a=3.5, k=5 waxay bixisaa garaaf maraya labada dhibic. Macluumaadka la aamino waa in lagu go'aamiyaa isha macluumaadka iyo in la hubin karo.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Dib u qor k sida 6 oo hilmaan dhibicdii hore (0, 1)
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Haddii k=6, markaas y=0 marka x=0, taasoo is-khilaafsan dhibicda hore la bixiyay (0, 1). Ka fikir in sabab jirto oo macluumaadkii hore loo tuuro.
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Maadaama shuruudaha (labada asymptote iyo labada dhibic) isla mar aanay run ahayn, waa inaan hubinno shuruudda khaldan
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Macluumaadka ku saabsan (4, 6) waxaa laga yaabaa in si khaldan loo gudbiyay, sidaa darteed k=4 sidiisa u daay ilaa la xaqiijiyo
y-m-50-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Aamin asymptote-ka toosan x=2 laakiin ka fikir in asymptote-ka jiifka uusan ahayn y=3, oo mar kale ka hel
y-m-50-05.s.s1.reflect: Si toos ah u eeg habka hubinta macluumaadka cusub, mar kasta oo macluumaadku kordho, in 'xukunkii hore weli sax yahay'. Sidoo kale xaqiiji in sababo dhowr ah ay suurtagal ahaayeen marka macluumaadku is-khilaafay.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.prompt: Aan raadinno shaqo jajab ah y=a+k/(x-2) oo maraysa dhibicda (0, 1) iyo dhibicda (4, 6) labadaba oo leh asymptote toosan x=2. Markan, asymptote-ka jiifka ha ka dhigin y=3 oo a sidoo kale u daawo mid aan la oga. Geli (a, k) suurtagal ah.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.hint.0: Geli (0, 1) si aad u qorto xiriir u dhexeeya a iyo k, oo geli (4, 6) si aad u qorto xiriir kale.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir immisa (a, k) ayaa isla mar buuxiya labada xiriir.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Haddii k=0, ma aha shaqo jajab ah. Fadlan isticmaal tiro aan eber ahayn.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c2: y ma noqonayo 1 marka x=0. Geli (0, 1) tibaaxda si aad u hubiso.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.fail.c3: y ma noqonayo 6 marka x=4. Geli (4, 6) tibaaxda si aad u hubiso.
y-m-50-05.s.s2.explain: Marka labada dhibic la geliyo waxay bixisaa a-k/2=1 iyo a+k/2=6; isku darkoodu wuxuu bixiyaa 2a=7, a=3.5, jaridduna waxay bixisaa k=5. y=3.5+5/(x-2), oo asymptote-keeda jiifka ahi yahay y=3.5, wuxuu maraa labada dhibic. Shuruudahan waxaa jira hal xal oo keliya.

y-m-50-07.title: Haddii derbigu sii dheeraado, ma had iyo jeer ayuu xerada sii weynaan doonaa?
y-m-50-07.topic: Xaddidaadda aagga qiimaha ee dhibaatada ugu badan ee shaqada labajibaaran (haddii dhibicda sare ay ku jirto ama ka baxsan tahay muddada)
y-m-50-07.goal: Ku xukun, iyadoo ku xiran shuruudda aagga, in ugu badnaanta shaqada labajibaaran ay ka dhacdo dhibicda sare ama dhammaadka muddada, dib u eeg ama ilaali xukunkaaga marka shuruudda is beddesho, oo adigu samee miis ugu badnaanta shuruud kasta.
y-m-50-07.material: Waxaan dhisaynaa xero afargees ah anagoo isticmaalayna dhammaan 20 m oo ah deyr. Hal dhinac ayaa derbi toosan lagu dhejiyay, dhinacaas deyr lama isticmaalo. Haddii dhererka dhinaca derbiga lagu dhejiyay (dhinaca derbiga la barbar socda) uu yahay x m, dhererka dhinaca ka soo hoosaysa uu yahay y m, markaas x+2y=20, aagga A=xy (㎡, mitir labajibaaran) waa A=x(20-x)/2. (x dhuftay '20 laga jaray x', loo qaybiyay 2) x waa ka weyn yahay 0 oo ka yar yahay 20. Dhererka dhinaca derbiga lagu dhejiyay x ma dhaafi karo dhererka derbiga.
y-m-50-07.thinking.0: Dib u eeg xukun marka shuruudaha is beddelaan
y-m-50-07.thinking.1: Kala saar meesha ugu badnaanta ka dhacdo (dhibicda sare ama dhammaadka muddada)
y-m-50-07.thinking.2: Ku abaabul natiijooyinka shuruud kasta miis
y-m-50-07.prereq.0: 'H1' ee hawshan waa calaamad adag oo keliya oo ku jirta qoondaynta soo saarista mana ahan in manhajku wax ku baraa fasal gaar ah. Aasaas: ka soo qaad inaad horey u taqaan dhibicda sare ee shaqo labajibaaran iyo helidda ugu badnaanta aagga la xaddiday (waxaa lagu xukumaa qaabka garaafka), iyo dhisidda tibaax adigoo dhererka dhinacyada ka dhigaya xarfo.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.prompt: Mar kasta oo macluumaadka ku saabsan dhererka derbigu is beddelo, ku xukun x-ka sameeya xerada ugu weyn, marka macluumaad cusub yimaado, go'aami inaad ilaalinayso ama dib u eegayso xukunkaaga.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.hint.0: Samee miis yar oo qiyamka x iyo A oo ka hel halka ugu weyn.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi in x-ka bixiya qiimaha ugu weyn miiska uu ku jiro aagga loo ogolyahay ee x.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Derbigu aad buu u dheer yahay, sidaa darteed x xadkii ma leh. (0<x<20)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kee x ayaa bixiya aagga ugu weyn?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.after: A(5)=37.5, A(10)=50, A(15)=37.5. Garaafka A=x(20-x)/2 waa parabola hoos u furan oo la dhicisa x=10, sidaa darteed x=10 ugu badnaantu waa 50㎡.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: A(5)=5×15/2=37.5. Xisaabi hal qiime oo kale si aad u is barbar dhigto waxa dhaca aagga marka x laga kordhiyo 5.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: A(15)=15×5/2=37.5. Xisaabi oo is barbar dhig in ay ka yar tahay 10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Waxaad ogaatay in dhererka derbigu yahay 8 m. (x waa 8 ama ka yar)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda, kee x ayaa sameeya xerada ugu weyn?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Aagga loo ogolyahay waa 0<x≤8, dhibicda sare x=10 waxay ka baxsan tahay aagga. Aagga gudihiisa, A wuu kordhaa marka x kordho, sidaa darteed ugu badnaantu waa dhammaadka x=8, halkaas A=8×12/2=48 (㎡).
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: x=10 waa 2 m ka dheer derbiga, sidaa darteed lagama dhejin karo derbiga. Fiiri sida A u beddelmayso aagga loo ogolyahay ee x.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Aagga x uu yahay 8 ama ka yar, xisaabi in A kordho ama yaraado marka laga bilaabo x=5 ilaa 8.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Derbigii waxaa loo guuriyay meel ka dheer, dhererka derbigu wuxuu noqday 12 m. (x waa 12 ama ka yar)
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kee x ayaa sameeya xerada ugu weyn?
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Aagga loo ogolyahay waa 0<x≤12, dhibicda sare x=10 waxay ku jirtaa aagga. Ugu badnaantu waa 50㎡ dhibicda sare, dhammaadka derbiga, x=12, waa 48㎡, taasoo ka yar. Isticmaalka derbiga ilaa dhammaadkiisa had iyo jeer ma aha kan ugu wanaagsan.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: A(11)=11×9/2=49.5. Is barbar dhig qiimaha x=10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Haddii aad derbiga u isticmaasho ilaa dhammaadkiisa, A(12)=12×8/2=48. Is barbar dhig qiimaha x=10.
y-m-50-07.s.s1.reflect: Iyadoo ku xiran dhererka derbiga, ugu badnaanta mararka qaar waxay ka dhacday 'dhibicda sare' mararka qaarna 'dhammaadka muddada'. Dib u eeg waxa aad si cusub u hubisay marka aad beddeshay xukunkaaga.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.prompt: Samee miis aagga ugu weyn A (㎡) ee aad dhisi karto marka dhererka derbigu yahay w m (0<w≤20). Geli saddex lammaane (w, A) oo leh aagga ugu badan oo kala duwan.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro w, qor aagga loo ogolyahay ee x, kadibna ka hel halka A ugu weyn yahay aaggaas.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.hint.1: U beddel w 4, 8, 12, iyo wixii kale, oo is barbar dhig sida x-ka bixiya ugu badnaanta u kala duwan yahay.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Dhererka derbigu wuxuu ku jiraa aagga.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Fadlan w ka dhig ka weyn 0 oo ugu badnaan 20.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Waa aagga ugu weyn ee aad ku dhisi karto derbigaas.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kani maaha aagga ugu weyn ee aad ku dhisi karto w-gan. Mar kale ka hel halka A ugu weyn yahay aagga loo ogolyahay ee x.
y-m-50-07.s.s2.explain: Haddii w uu yahay 10 ama ka yar, ugu badnaantu waa dhammaadka x loo ogolyahay, x=w; haddii w uu yahay 10 ama ka badan, waa dhibicda sare x=10. Tusaale ahaan, w=4 wuxuu bixiyaa 32, w=8 wuxuu bixiyaa 48, w=10 wuxuu bixiyaa 50, w=15 wuxuu bixiyaa 50 (㎡). w kala duwan oo bixiya isla aag wuxuu dhacaa marka w uu yahay 10 ama ka badan.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.prompt: Ku xukun in hadalka "Marka derbigu sii dheeraado, xerada aad dhisi karto ayaa sii weynaata" had iyo jeer sax yahay, oo sharax adigoo adeegsanaya tirooyinka miiska aad hadda samaysay sida caddayn.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.hint.0: Raac bilow ilaa dhammaad sida qiimaha A u beddelmay marka w kordhay miiska aad hadda samaysay.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka hel qiimaha w halka A uu joojiyo inuu weynaado.

y-m-50-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay dhererka xadka darbiga (10 m) adigoo lambar isticmaalaya?
y-m-50-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma dib u xisaabisay A si toos ah tusaalayaasha lambarka ah?
y-m-50-07.s.s3.model.0: Haddii darbigu yahay 8 m, ugu badnaan waa 48㎡, haddii uu yahay 12 m na waa 50㎡, xitaa 15 m waa isla 50㎡. Ilaa 10 m, darbi ka dheer wuxuu siiyaa bed ka weyn, laakiin ka dib, dheeraad faa'iido ma leh, sidaas darteed 'mar walba' waa khalad.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.model.1: Mar walba sax ma aha. Darbi 4 m wuxuu siinayaa 32㎡, 8 m na 48㎡, wuu kordhaa, laakiin laga bilaabo 10 m iyo wixii ka sarreeya wuxuu sii ahaanayaa 50㎡. Ugu sarreeya waa x=10, sidaas darteed xitaa haddii darbigu ka dheeraado taas, bedku ma kordho.
y-m-50-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Jawaab bixisay booska fiiqda sida sabab.
